senses.gloss: m. pl. (v. פַּרְדַּסְקִין) boxes, caskets used as bird’s nests.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 141b:13">Ḥull. 141ᵇ</cite> <he>אהדר לה רבא פ׳ ותפשה</he> (Ms. M. <he>פרסקי</he>; Ms. R. 2 <he>פרקיקי</he> or <he>פרסקי</he>; Ms. F. <he>פרטקיה</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) R. had boxes set around it (the bird that he let fly), and then caught it.
